tools.name: classify_germline_variant
tools.description: Classify one GRCh38 germline nuclear SNV or simple indel smaller than 50 bp under ACMG/AMP. Accepts genomic, coding or protein HGVS, coordinates, SPDI, rsID or a returned canonical key. Returns normalized identity, automated classification, applied criteria, ClinVar assertions, population frequencie

tools.name: search_variant_literature
tools.description: Resolve one GRCh38 germline variant and retrieve publications from the PubMed-derived genetics corpus. Exact variant mentions rank ahead of broader gene associations. Returns match types, source links, corpus provenance and retrieval time.

tools.name: get_publication_details
tools.description: Retrieve one PMID from the PubMed-derived genetics corpus, including title, abstract, authors, journal, publication types, MeSH terms, gene and variant mentions, retraction status and PubMed/PMC links.

tools.name: search_literature_corpus
tools.description: Search the genetics Literature Corpus by question, PMID, DOI, PMCID, gene, variant, phenotype, HPO or OMIM concept. Known publication identifiers provide exact anchors. Returns ranked publications, match types, scores and source links.

tools.name: support_helena
tools.description: Retrieve Helena Good campaign, rules, manifest and MCP connection URLs.

tools.name: get_gene_disease_associations
tools.description: Find diseases associated with an exact gene symbol or HGNC identifier. Returns ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions, relation-specific inheritance, source reports and snapshot provenance, including conflicting and limited assertions.

tools.name: search_disease_genes
tools.description: Find genes associated with an exact MONDO identifier or disease-name search. Returns ClinGen validity assertions with inheritance, source reports and snapshot provenance. Name searches can return multiple disease identities.

tools.name: resolve_gene
tools.description: Resolve a human gene symbol, previous symbol, alias, HGNC, Ensembl or NCBI Gene identifier. Returns exact, alias, ambiguous, not_found or withdrawn status with candidates and identity_snapshot_id. Use a selected HGNC gene_id and snapshot_id with get_gene_profile. Gene-plus-HGVS and variant expressio

tools.name: get_gene_profile
tools.description: Read the selected gene_id and immutable snapshot_id from resolve_gene. Returns overview, disease validity, dosage, mechanisms, transcripts, native assemblies, constraint, ClinVar summaries and consequences, expression, GWAS, phenotypes and protein/pathways with source assertions, coverage, count uni

tools.name: get_gene_section
tools.description: Read a gene-profile section using gene_id, snapshot_id and its returned opaque cursor. Returns source records, assembly/release, coverage, totals, count units and provenance. snapshot_unavailable requires a fresh resolution/profile request.

tools.name: search_gene_literature
tools.description: Retrieve a live publication capture for a resolved gene_id and snapshot_id. Returns source links, match labels, capture time/hash, degradation and gene/snapshot/sort-bound cursors. This capture is separate from the immutable reference snapshot and contains no abstracts.
